ooda.today: Staff fuse sources at the weekly int conference; threat level argued, not scored
ooda.cw: RAG, trend arrow, confidence and the drivers computed in seconds; J2 reviews in 30 min
ooda.how: Same scoring rules every day; drivers shown, so the review is about judgement, not arithmetic

ooda.today: Options built at the weekly ops/int conference
ooda.cw: Three ranked actions from a playbook, ready for the 0700 commander's update
ooda.how: Options pre-built and ranked; the commander chooses, staff do not start from a blank page

ooda.today: Orders drafted and passed down after the decision
ooda.cw: Each action already has an owner, a timeline and a trigger; FLASH reaches the owner on ingest
ooda.how: Pre-agreed triggers turn the next escalation into a drill, not a new decision
